_comment: International shipping + payment config. FLAG OFF until the accounts/keys exist. While intlEnabled is false the storefront behaves exactly as today: Colombia -> Bold, no address step. Fill the PENDIENTE fields and flip intlEnabled to true (plus set the env keys) to go live per zone.
